law_conditions.signal: Ego governing steady red held for all sampled frames; cross-signal observed green-yellow-red-green transitions count complete cycles
law_conditions.qualified_actor: Native vehicle.kawasaki.ninja motorcycle type and two-wheel physics readback
law_conditions.full_halt: At least 10 consecutive 20 Hz frames with speed <=0.05 m/s and motorcycle front before y=-14 m prior to crossing
law_conditions.failed_detection: Explicit held-red and withheld-detector-request command recorded; physical causal malfunction remains unproven until Native run and independent review
law_conditions.conditional_permission: Two complete cross-signal cycles while ego red before turn, no turn-prohibiting device, and yield to pedestrians and other traffic
law_conditions.controlled_negative: Condition B stops and yields identically but enters after one complete cycle
law_conditions.nearest_halt_reference: Authored stop line y=-14 m; Native map and body readback required

frame_contract.join: video_frame == native_frame == sequential frame and time_s == frame/20
frame_contract.body_offset_status: Synthetic motorcycle proxy; Native body vertices replace it

fallbacks.fallback1: max route cross-track error > 0.45 m from original Native ego pose and map route
fallbacks.fallback2: second complete cross-signal cycle frame > 280 from original Native cross-signal phases joined to ego red
fallbacks.fallback3: minimum signal or body pixel margin < 40 px in decoded original overview video

scope: Authored CPU construction and synthetic saved-path proof only; not Native readback, original pixels, physical trigger observations, statutory outcome, or accepted recording
